page.overview:
Who is Alex Carvill?

Alex Carvill is a minor character in Cars 2 — part of Pixar.

He is a Fiat Panda and a security officer at Porto Corsa for the World Grand Prix. After the race, as he is controlling the cars entering the press-only area, he with his partner finds himself struggling with Mater.

Thinking with his partner Mater is insane, he tries unsuccessfully to stop him from entering the area.
